title: Pricing matrix rollout and sales enablement cadence
creator: Rafael Ortega
description:
Goal: Coordinate a safe, observable rollout of the new pricing matrix and SKU definitions across hosted and dedicated offerings, align release notes and billing comms, and equip Sales + CS with playbooks and migration tooling. This ticket covers cross-team orchestration (Eng, Finance, Billing, Legal, Sales Ops, Docs, Support).

Scope and non-goals:
- Included: SKU naming, limits matrix, billing migration strategy (soft migration + backfill), release notes, email billing communications, dashboard banner copy, sales playbook + objection handling, enablement sessions, support macros.
- Not included: changes to Dedicated capacity SLA language (separate legal PR), on-prem license agreements (follow-up PM ticket).

Decision notes & trade-offs:
- Opted for a 2-week opt-in migration window followed by automatic backfill, rather than immediate forced migration, to reduce billing disputes and give customers time to opt into savings.
- SKU granularity: chose 3-tier SKU mapping (base / reserved / enterprise) to balance simplicity for Sales and fidelity for Finance reporting. Trade-off: fewer SKUs increase mapping variance in billing analytics; Finance to add reporting tags to compensate.
- Limits enforcement: throttles will be enforced server-side at cutover; we will surface hard limits in console 48h before enforcement window to reduce surprises.

Operational checklist (high level):
- Finalize SKU table and examples (billing + usage mapping) — owner: Finance (Asha Patel) — due 2026-03-05 (done)
- Billing backfill plan and PRD — owner: Billing Eng (Devon Li) — due 2026-03-08 (in review)
- Release notes draft and public-facing FAQ — owner: Docs (Lena Morris) — due 2026-03-12 (in progress)
- Sales playbook & objection guides — owner: Sales Enablement (Noah Kim) — due 2026-03-14 (draft)
- Support macros and escalation flow — owner: Support Ops (Priya Singh) — due 2026-03-15 (ready for review)
- Dashboard banner / banner schedule — owner: Console PM (Jordan Blake) — content due 2026-03-16

Key timelines:
- 2026-03-12: Internal all-hands and final sign-offs (Finance & Legal)
- 2026-03-16: Public release notes + support resources published
- 2026-03-17: Customer-facing banner and in-console migration CTA goes live
- 2026-03-17 to 2026-03-31: Opt-in migration window
- 2026-04-01: Automatic backfill and limits enforcement

Release notes coordination:
- Single source: Confluence pricing release doc (link below). Docs will push a trimmed public release note and FAQ. Engineering will attach the migration runbook and any known limitations.
- We will include an explicitly labeled "billing change" section in the release notes and a step-by-step migration guide for customers.
- Legal approved the release language for EU customers with additional data residency note appended.

Billing communications strategy:
- Phase 1 (Pre-announce, 2026-03-10): Email to account owners for customers in affected SKUs explaining upcoming changes and migration CTA.
- Phase 2 (Launch day, 2026-03-16): Public release notes + dashboard CTA + in-console banner for all users.
- Phase 3 (Reminder + cutover notice, 2026-03-29): Second email + top-of-console persistent banner 48h before enforcement.
- Dispute handling: Support will mark any billing dispute opened within 7 days of enforcement for Finance review; Slack channel #pricing-billing-wg established for rapid escalation.

Sales enablement:
- Single-slide summary (1 pager) with example customer scenarios and net delta calculations per common usage profiles.
- Objection playbook (price increase vs optimized packaging messaging). Emphasis on predictable unit economics and migration savings.
- Two 45-minute live enablement sessions with recording links and one-pager cheat sheet.
- Account prioritization list exported from CSMs for high-touch outreach (top 50 accounts).

Metrics and observability:
- Pre/post migration metrics: number of opt-ins, delta in average bill per customer, disputes opened, support volume spike, telemetry on limit triggers.
- Dashboards: billing-ops (Finance) and console-alerts (Eng) required before cutover. ENG-3021 to provide limit enforcement metrics and instrumentation.

Rollout risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Billing disputes spike — Mitigation: extend manual review window and provide proactive credits for legitimate migration errors.
- Risk: Dashboard CTA not visible to some customers — Mitigation: coordinate with Console team to validate feature flags in 5 sample accounts.
- Risk: Sales confusion on SKU mapping — Mitigation: host office hours and publish mapping CSV with examples.

Next steps (immediate):
- Maya: coordinate final marketing email copy with Marketing (send draft to #mgmt for approval by 2026-03-09).
- Finance: publish final sku-catalog.csv to shared drive and tag columns, then confirm integration with billing engine.
- Eng: validate throttle behavior in staging and tag ENG-3021 as a blocker for enforcement readiness.

Attachments & artifacts are below in Links.
